parent_objective: implement bounded no-PPO trainable-scope source-history diagnostic
blocked_by: M1298 designs the trainable-scope diagnostic but no implementation artifacts exist

public_gates: M1299 must preserve actor input contract
M1299 must not use private holdout
M1299 must report train/eval/full directional metrics
M1299 must classify the trainable-scope result as strong, mixed, negative, or contract artifact
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train prefix GRU histories in this implementation
do not mutate critic log_std sequence_tail privileged modules or actor input encoders unless explicitly scoped
do not treat public split success as paper-level holdout evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether response_context_fusion plus actor_mean can use fixed source-history hidden states directionally
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any forbidden parameter group mutates
stop if split-eval metrics are missing
stop if implementation requires actor-input expansion
fallback_plan: if strong, route to result audit and proof-retention design
if mixed, route to result audit and decide current-step GRU/fusion or corpus refresh
if negative, route to source-history corpus refresh or sequence preference design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: second milestone in trainable-scope escalation branch

admission_evidence: M1298 defines allowed scopes and split-eval
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1299 uses fixed-current intervention observations and source-history hidden states; it does not prove closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: correct-history versus wrong-history directional metrics must be reported
source-diverse split metrics must be reported
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1280 source-history prefixes with fixed M1277 intervention observations.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If wider scope remains mixed or negative, keep PPO blocked and route to audit/corpus refresh.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: Training response_context_fusion plus actor_mean can improve source-history directional metrics beyond M1295 while preserving actor input and mutation guards.
success_criteria: full/train/eval directional and group metrics are reported
forbidden parameter mutation flag is false
result class is strong, mixed, negative, or contract artifact
no PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: thresholds are relaxed after seeing results
decision_rule: M1299 passes as diagnostic infrastructure if it reports split-eval trainable-scope results without forbidden mutations and routes to audit.
